public_payload.normalized_proposition: No generative AI company is profitable.

statement.excerpt: there are no profitable generative AI companies

our_interpretation: Read companies as businesses principally developing generative models or selling products built on them, including application companies.
The ordinary reading of profitable is positive company-wide net income after expenses, rather than revenue growth, gross profit, or positive cash flow.
Use July–September 2025, the latest completed calendar quarter that could ordinarily have been financially reported before the December 31 post.
The sentence supplies no accounting basis. Do not silently substitute company-defined profitability or an adjusted measure.
Treat the retrospective as repeating a current claim; the linked July essay creates some uncertainty about whether only the earlier period was intended.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial records show no positive company-wide net income among the defined companies during the target period, with sufficient coverage to substantiate the universal claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one qualifying company has documented positive company-wide net income in the target period on an accounting basis matching the claim.
